name: IN-03
label: Safe R

key_factors: Stutzman's large fundraising and outside-spending edge
No polls or expert ratings; markets price Democratic win at ~4%
model.rationale: The R+16 district, incumbent Stutzman's dominant fundraising and outside support, and Polymarket pricing a Democratic win at just 4% all point to a safe Republican hold; the challenger's thin finances reinforce that.
model.watch: Any late polling or a major outside-spending surge for Thompson would be the first sign the race is closer than fundamentals suggest.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Indiana's 3rd District is a solidly Republican seat, and incumbent Marlin Stutzman is running for reelection after easily securing his nomination. The district's partisan lean of roughly sixteen points Republican sets a high bar for any challenger. Stutzman has raised more than $839,000 and benefits from about $15,000 in outside support, while Democrat Kelly Thompson has raised about $136,000 with only around $6,000 left on hand.

No public polls or expert ratings cover this race, so the outlook rests on fundamentals and prediction markets, which give Thompson only about a 4% chance. The expected result is a comfortable Republican win in the mid-to-high teens, with modest uncertainty given the absence of polling.
